description: JANAVI (Papermark fork) module dependency map — key subsystems, their files, and inter-module dependencies. Update after significant refactors.

app_router: app/api/* views, views-dataroom, views/pages, cron/*, feature-flags, webhooks/{callback,signing}
app/(ee)/api/* [COMMERCIAL] saml, scim, ai, workflows, freeze, faqs
pages_router: pages/view/[linkId]/* public viewer (ISR) + custom domains variant
pages/api/** owner-side APIs, auth/[...nextauth], file/tus*, links/download/**, mupdf/*, jobs/*, record_*

viewer_chain.entry: pages/view/[linkId]/index.tsx → fetchLinkDataById (lib/api/links/link-data.ts) → DocumentView (components/view/document-view.tsx) → AccessForm → POST /api/views → ViewData (components/view/view-data.tsx)

write: pages/api/file/tus/[[...file]].ts (+tus-viewer) w/ lib/files/tus-redis-locker.ts + ee MultiRegionS3Store [EE dep — storage config also drives AGPL paths]
storage.config: lib/files/storage-config.ts + lib/files/tus-s3-store.ts (JANAVI-owned, replaced ee/features/storage); same NEXT_PRIVATE_UPLOAD_* env

processing.tasks_missing_ee: ee/features/conversions/lib/trigger/convert-files.ts — MISSING; docs/slides/key conversion dispatch dangles (JANAVI must implement independent converter)

dataroom_domain.api: pages/api/teams/[teamId]/datarooms/** (folders, documents, groups, permission-groups, views, branding, download)

email.transport: lib/resend.ts central sendEmail dispatches via Beacon (lib/emails/beacon.ts) when BEACON_API_TOKEN set; Resend fallback; from-addresses env-driven JANAVI_EMAIL_*
email.jobs: pages/api/jobs/* (INTERNAL_API_KEY) + trigger notification tasks + QStash cron digests (lib/redis/dataroom-notification-queue.ts)

redis.client: lib/redis.ts dual-transport facade: Redis Cloud ioredis (lib/janavi/redis.ts, keyPrefix janavi:dev:, Lua sliding-window ratelimit) | Upstash REST | stub; edge runtime gets stub (ioredis Node-only)
stores: lib/redis-job-store.ts (export jobs: export_job:*, user_jobs:*, team_jobs:*, cleanup zset)

auth.config: lib/auth/auth-options.ts (Google, LinkedIn, Email magic-link + Redis login code, Hanko passkeys, SAML [EE]) → pages/api/auth/[...nextauth].ts

branding_janavi.note: IMPLEMENTED: lib/branding/* (14 modules incl. janavi.ts constants) + components/branding/* (8) — independent JANAVI replacements, all 29 importers repointed

external_services.postgres: Prisma → POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL(_NON_POOLING/_SHADOW); JANAVI: RDS janavi_dev via DB_* (lib/janavi/db-env.ts)
external_services.redis: Upstash REST (existing) | Redis Cloud REDIS_URL (JANAVI, lib/janavi/redis.ts, prefix janavi:dev:)
external_services.s3_cloudfront: NEXT_PRIVATE_UPLOAD_* env; dual region EU/US; archive bucket
external_services.removed: Stripe (dep uninstalled), SAML/SCIM (jackson), Dub tracking, Cal embed — 2026-10-16
